subject: storytime
title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
about: Aesop's fable of the bored shepherd boy who yells Wolf! for fun until nobody believes him; in this telling the real wolf only scatters the sheep and nobody gets hurt. It is one of the fables in the NC/CKLA Grade 1 Fables and Stories domain, and the clearest first-grade example of a story with a lesson. It is a public-domain story retold here in first-grade words, three pages long.
tip: Ask: why did nobody come the third time, and what could the boy do to be trusted again?

book.author: Aesop (retold)
book.source: public domain, retold in first-grade words
book.blurb: A boy who tricks the village one time too many.

passage.text:
A boy kept the sheep on a hill.
All day he sat and sat.
It was not much fun.
"I know," he said.
"I will play a trick."
He ran down the hill.
"Wolf! Wolf!" he yelled.
"A wolf is after the sheep!"
The people from the village ran up the hill.
There was no wolf.
The boy just laughed.
***
The next day, the boy did it again.
"Wolf! Wolf!" he yelled.
The people ran up the hill.
There was no wolf.
The boy laughed and laughed.
The people were upset.
"Do not trick us," they said.
"Tell the truth."
***
Then one day, a real wolf came.
It ran at the sheep.
"Wolf! Wolf!" the boy yelled.
"Help! It is a real wolf!"
But no one came.
They thought it was a trick again.
The wolf chased the sheep all over the hill.
The boy felt very sad.
It took all day to get the sheep back.
Tell the truth, so people will trust you.

cards.q: Who kept the sheep on the hill?
cards.note: Someone who looks after sheep is called a shepherd.
The village is down below, so the people have to run up the hill each time.

cards.q: What did the boy yell to trick the people?
cards.note: That yell is why the story is called The Boy Who Cried Wolf; cried means yelled here.

cards.q: What did the real wolf do to the sheep?
cards.note: In this telling the sheep are only scattered; it takes all day to get them back.

cards.q: What happened first in the story?
cards.note: He was bored, so he played a trick, and then he played it again.

cards.q: What happened at the end of the story?
cards.note: The third time nobody came, and the boy had to gather the sheep himself.

cards.q: How did the people feel when they were tricked again?
cards.note: Ask how he feels when someone tricks him; that is why they stopped coming.
If you tell lies, people stop trusting you, even when you tell the truth.

cards.q: In the story, what does 'village' mean?
cards.note: A village is a small town where the people all know each other.

cards.q: Which word is in the story?
cards.note: He reads the three words himself; only one of them is in the story.
